title: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarship
description: Merit-cum-means scholarship supporting ambitious undergraduate students in computer science, mathematics, and emerging technology degrees across India.
checklist: Provide proof of household annual income

title: Generation Google Scholarship (APAC)

eligibilityCriteria.focus: Computer Science or related technical field

description: Awarded to aspiring students who excel in computing and demonstrate a strong commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in tech. Includes mentorship access.
checklist: Write responses to two short essay questions

title: Tata Capital Pankh Scholarship Programme
description: Financial assistance for meritorious students from economically disadvantaged backgrounds pursuing professional undergraduate courses in STEM and management.
checklist: Fill online application on Buddy4Study portal
Write a 300-word essay on career goals
Provide ration card or BPL certificate if applicable

title: PMSSS – Prime Minister's Special Scholarship Scheme
amount: Up to Rs 30,000 per year (tuition) + Rs 1,00,000 (maintenance)
description: Special scheme for students from J&K and Ladakh pursuing higher education in institutions outside J&K. Covers tuition and living costs. Administered through AICTE.
checklist: Apply on AICTE portal with J&K domicile proof
Upload admission offer letter from approved institute

title: NSP Central Sector Scholarship Scheme
provider: Ministry of Education / National Scholarship Portal
description: Central government scholarship for undergraduate and postgraduate students from low-income families who scored in the top 20th percentile in their board exams.
checklist: Submit income certificate from competent authority
Upload bonafide certificate for current year

title: Adobe Digital Academy Scholarship – India

eligibilityCriteria.focus: Computer Science, UX Design, or Creative Technology

description: Awarded to students who demonstrate exceptional creativity and technical ability in design, computer science, or digital media. Includes internship referral at Adobe.
checklist: Build a portfolio of design or CS projects

title: Narotam Sekhsaria Foundation Scholarship
amount: Up to Rs 20,00,000 for PG at IITs/IIMs and abroad
description: Merit-cum-means scholarship for postgraduate study in India and abroad. Covers tuition, living, and travel. Focuses on motivated students pursuing excellence in STEM or law.
checklist: Submit academic transcripts of all prior degrees
Write a detailed statement of purpose (2000 words)
Provide three reference letters from professors
Attach admission offer letter from target institution
Submit proof of annual family income
Fill the scholarship application form online

title: Amazon Future Engineer Scholarship
description: Supports first-year CS/Engineering students from underserved backgrounds to sustain and excel in their undergraduate studies. Includes Amazon mentorship sessions.
checklist: Register on Amazon Future Engineer India portal
Provide income certificate for current financial year
Write a 400-word essay on your tech journey
Confirm enrollment in an eligible B.Tech/BE programme
Obtain institute NOC or enrollment confirmation

title: Kishore Vaigyanik Protsahan Yojana (KVPY) Fellowship

eligibilityCriteria.focus: Pure Sciences: Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology

description: National fellowship to identify students with strong aptitude for research in basic sciences. Fellows gain access to national laboratories, IISc, and IISERs for summer projects.
checklist: Prepare for the written aptitude test
Submit class 12 marksheet or college enrollment proof
Link scholarship to bank account post-selection

title: HDFC Bank Parivartan Scholarship
description: Supports meritorious students from economically weaker sections pursuing professional courses. Covers tuition, accommodation, and study material. Managed via Buddy4Study portal.
checklist: Submit income proof (Form 16 or salary slips)
Upload Aadhaar card and bank passbook
Write a 200-word essay on your financial challenges

title: Infosys Foundation Scholarship for Women in STEM
description: Scholarship exclusively for women students pursuing STEM undergraduate degrees, to help close the gender gap in technology and engineering careers.
checklist: Verify eligibility (women students in STEM UG programme)
Write a personal statement on career goals in STEM (500 words)
Upload proof of enrollment for current academic year

title: Dr. Reddy's Foundation BOLD Scholarship
description: Empowers students from low-income families through financial support, career guidance, mentoring, and job placement assistance. Focuses on employability alongside academics.
checklist: Apply via Dr. Reddy's Foundation portal
Submit family BPL or income certificate
Write a statement on how this scholarship will help your career
Provide reference from teacher or NGO worker

title: Microsoft Scholarship Program – India

eligibilityCriteria.focus: Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Data Science

description: For undergraduate or graduate students pursuing CS/engineering with a commitment to community leadership and creating inclusive technology. Includes Microsoft Mentorship access.
checklist: Complete the online application on Microsoft Careers
Write two essays on leadership and community impact
Confirm degree program and enrollment status

title: Aditya Birla Scholarship
description: Prestigious scholarship for first-year students admitted to India's premier institutions. Covers tuition, living, and books. Selection includes a rigorous interview process.
checklist: Register on the Aditya Birla Scholars portal
Provide offer or admission letter from premier institution
Write a 500-word essay on your life goal
Provide bank account details for disbursement

title: LIC Golden Jubilee Scholarship
description: Government-backed LIC scholarship for fresh undergraduate students from economically weaker sections. Renewable annually based on academic performance.
checklist: Provide income certificate from state authority
Upload Aadhaar card and caste certificate if applicable
Provide bank account linked with Aadhaar
Obtain bonafide letter from current college

title: Wipro Cares Scholarship
description: Wipro's CSR scholarship for meritorious students from disadvantaged backgrounds studying in IT and Engineering programmes. Includes a Wipro mentorship component.
checklist: Fill Wipro Cares scholarship application form
Upload marksheet from previous academic year
Write a 300-word essay on your career vision
Obtain one recommendation letter from faculty

title: Sitaram Jindal Foundation Scholarship
amount: Rs 1,000 to Rs 3,000 per month (based on course)
description: Monthly financial support for students pursuing professional, graduate, and postgraduate courses from economically weaker sections. One of India's largest private scholarship programs.
checklist: Download application form from the foundation website
Fill and submit physical or online application

title: Central Sector Scheme Scholarship – Minorities
description: Scholarship for minority community students (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Zoroastrian) to pursue higher education and enhance their employment prospects.

title: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)
provider: Department of Science and Technology (DST), Govt of India
amount: Rs 80,000 per year + Rs 20,000 mentorship grant

eligibilityCriteria.focus: Natural and Basic Sciences (Physics, Chemistry, Math, Biology, Stats)

description: DST's flagship scheme to attract talent to basic sciences. For students who score in top 1% in Class 12 board exams and pursue science UG. Includes summer research internship grants.
checklist: Provide admission proof in eligible B.Sc / BS programme

title: PRAGATI Scholarship for Girls – AICTE
description: AICTE scholarship for women students in technical education. One scholarship per family. Covers fees and educational expenses. Disbursed via DBT directly to student account.
checklist: Verify that admission is in an AICTE-approved institution
Upload Aadhaar and bank account details
Confirm only one girl from the family is applying

title: Endowment Fund Scholarship – IIT Alumni Network
description: Endowment-funded scholarships for meritorious students at IITs, NITs, and IISERs who come from economically challenged families. Includes alumni mentoring network access.
checklist: Apply through your institution's scholarship office
Submit CGPA transcript verified by the institute
Write a personal statement on academic and financial need
Provide bank account details for NEFT disbursement

title: OPJEMS – O.P. Jindal Engineering and Management Scholarship
description: Merit scholarship for top students at IITs, NITs, and IIMs pursuing engineering or management. Recognizes academic brilliance and leadership potential. Selection includes personal interviews.
checklist: Apply online on the OPJEMS portal
Obtain two recommendation letters (one from HOD)
Write a 600-word essay on your leadership experience
Attend a virtual interview with the scholarship committee
